_comment: Hero photo slider. Each slide needs 'image' (a path under images/, landscape - roughly 2000x800 or wider works best) and 'alt'. Optional 'heading', 'text' and a 'link' with 'linkLabel' draw a caption over the photo; leave them out for a photo-only slide, which is what these are - the hero already carries its own headline. The order alternates daylight and floodlit frames, and boys' and girls' sport, so no two consecutive slides look alike. While this list is empty the hero falls back to its plain gradient, so the page never shows an empty banner.
